title: guarea glabra subsp. excelsa
intro: Guarea glabra subsp. excelsa, commonly known as West African kebabe, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Guarea glabra subsp. excelsa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, prevent the growth of microorganisms, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
